description.value:
While you don't like to talk about it, you have a connection to one of the most dangerous cults in the Universe: the cult of the Devourer. Perhaps you used to be a member of this nihilistic religious cult, a close friend or family member joined their ranks, or you were once a victim of their predations. Whatever the connection, you slipped away and have been laying low ever since.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and the Devourer Lore skill. You gain one of the following skill feats of your choice: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Face in the Crowd] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Lengthy Diversion].
